# mooncake vault

Manage Age-encrypted secrets stored in a vault directory

## Description

Store secrets encrypted at rest in your config repo.

Secrets are Age-encrypted files resolved at apply time via `!secret vault:<path>`.

Environment variables:
  MOONCAKE_VAULT_IDENTITY  path to the Age identity file (default: ~/.config/mooncake/vault-identity.txt)
  MOONCAKE_VAULT_DIR       path to the vault directory   (default: ~/.config/mooncake/vault/)

## Subcommands

- [add](vault_add.md) — Add or update an encrypted secret
- [init](vault_init.md) — Generate a new Age identity (private key)
- [list](vault_list.md) — List secrets in the vault directory
- [pubkey](vault_pubkey.md) — Print the public key (Age recipient) of the current identity
